new_value: {"notes":"B4: trust-task-error once 24h pass without a successful sync; sync on a timer (systemd timer example); report last sync time.\nDECISION: commit and sync time go in payload.ext[\"org.kernel.git-vouch\"] = {commit, synced}. Alternatives: message (pinned by an existing test, and it is the human reason) or a /status endpoint (a second surface to secure; TRQP clients ignore it). Why: the TRQP schema allows ext, and it rides on every answer. synced is an RFC 3339 timestamp, not an age: an age goes stale in caches and the client has issuedAt to subtract. FRESHNESS: the bridge resolves the copy git vouch query reads (vouch.registry set means $XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share, then git-vouch/registry, else cwd), so WorkingDirectory no longer matters. All git subprocesses take a QUERY_SLOTS slot. A stamp dated past CLOCK_SKEW in the future is refused. ext.commit is best-effort: read just before the query, so a sync between them can leave it one commit behind (follow-up filed). systemd units recorded on vouch-faq3.8."}
